specification: MicroSim: The Logic Gate Switchboard Type: Interactive p5.js Puzzle Goal: Wire up a switchboard using AND, OR, and NOT logic gates to route power to a neon sign. Features: - A drag-and-drop interface with logic gate blocks (&&, ||, !). - Draggable wires that connect different inputs (like toggle buttons or light sensors) to output targets. - Students must use Logical AND and Logical OR nodes to route the signals correctly based on the puzzle requirements (e.g., "The sign should only glow if Button 1 is ON AND Button 2 is OFF"). - Real-time evaluation: When the boolean conditions are met, the virtual neon sign glows!
